pages.text: A crafted Eulogia Crystal starts uncharged. Carry it high into the sky to let it absorb starlight. Charging begins at Y=96 by default.
The crystal uses a diamond core; the companion stone uses 3 Lapis Lazuli and 2 colorless glass blocks. Both start uncharged.
Crystals and companion stones charge in your inventory or on a Sky Offering Table. A crystal normally needs Y=96 and takes about 20 seconds; a companion stone needs Y=64 and takes about 10 seconds.
When charging finishes, the crystal icon and tooltip change. A charged Eulogia Crystal can be crafted with any stone into Celestial Stone; Celestial Glass is made through offering.
Celestial Stone is the base material for offering circles, tables, nodes, and vaults.
Celestial Stone slabs, stairs, and walls can all be used in the tier 1 altar frame.
